title: FOBI AI Inc. Announces Revocation of Failure to File Cease Trade Order
description: Vancouver, BC, July 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FOBI AI Inc. (FOBI:TSXV) (Pink:FOBIF) (“Fobi” or the “Company”), a company that harnesses AI and data intelligence to enable digital transformation, is pleased to announce that the British Columbia Securities Commission, as principal regulator of the Company, has issued a full revocation (the “Revocation”) of the failure-to-file cease trade order previously issued against the Company on November 1, 2024 (the “FFCTO”).
